subject: Recap & trial orientation agenda — Zenova evaluation
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@zenova.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@zenova.ai>
Date: 2027-05-20T15:10:00Z
Subject: Quick notes from today's demo + next steps

Evelyn / Ben — thanks for the demo today. Quick summary on our side and a couple of asks so we can move to an internal sign-off: 

Highlights we took away:
- Latency profile looked good for our 1k token typical requests (sub-200ms 95th on the smaller models).
- The KV prefix caching idea is promising for our interactive flows.
- Built-in rollout/fallback behavior is attractive from an ops perspective.

What we need to validate in a short trial (priority order):
1) Production-like inference latency with our burst pattern (attached sample logs).
2) Cost per 1k inference tokens for a sustained 24/7 runrate (ballpark pricing would help).
3) Assurance around logging/audit retention for customer data (SOC2 evidence).
4) Simple dev experience to push a minimal model variant and test routing rules.

Internal stakeholders:
- Alex Mercer (me) — technical lead
- Priya Rao — procurement & security
- Chris Lane (not on this thread) — infra lead (will loop him in if we move forward)

Requested deliverables from Redwood to get this kicked off:
- Proposed trial scope and timeline (we prefer a 4–6 week hands-on window).
- Trial artifact list (what access, tokens, datasets we need).
- Any baseline pricing guidance for a trial that may be followed by a dedicated commit.

Attached: zenova-demo-deck.pdf (small)

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Mercer
Head of Platform Engineering, Zenova Analytics
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@zenova.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-20T17:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick notes from today's demo + next steps

Alex — really appreciate the clear summary. Nice to meet you and Priya virtually. Below is a compact proposal for a hands-on evaluation that targets the items you listed. I kept the timeline tight so we can show impact quickly. 

Proposal: 5-week trial orientation (recommended)
- Week 0 (prep, 3 business days): account setup, access, ingest sample telemetry, connect a small routing rule.
- Week 1–3 (validation): run your burst/interactive load, validate latency & correctness, iterate on model variant and quantization profile.
- Week 4 (hardening): run a sustained run and verify logging/retention and fallbacks.
- Week 5 (wrap + decision): collect eval metrics, joint review, recommend next steps (dedicated capacity proposal).

Success criteria (proposed) — please confirm or edit:
- Latency: 95th <= 300ms for typical 1k-token requests across 90% of test cases.
- Quality: pass the 5 canonical prompts with at least the same or better F1/ROUGE than your baseline (we'll align prompts).
- Cost: unit inference cost within X% of the benchmark we'll provide (we'll share an honest estimate up-front).
- Operational: KV prefix cache reduces repeat-token cost by >= 20% on the chosen workload; audit logs retained for 90 days (configurable).

Ownership:
- Zenova: Alex (validation lead), Chris Lane (infra, to be looped in for network/procurement).
- Redwood: Evelyn (solution lead, trial config), Monica (CS, onboarding & day-to-day), Ben (account/contract).

Trial artifacts & access we'll provision:
- Short-lived trial API keys + test tenant (scoped)
- Sample workload harness (Python script to replay your burst pattern)
- Baseline benchmark harness to capture latency and cost per token
- One-pager trial outline attached: trial-outline-zenova.pdf

Pre-reqs from Zenova:
- A set of 20 canonical prompts/test cases (we can start with 10 and expand).
- Confirmation of the kickoff week (options below).
- SOC2 request (we can provide our SOC2 report and a short evidence bundle).

Kickoff options:
- Option A: Week of June 1 (preferred)
- Option B: Week of June 8

Related link: shared trial doc (we'll populate next steps & owners) — https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cZenovaTrialShared

Next steps (for this week):
1) Alex: confirm internal stakeholders + preferred kickoff window.
2) Priya: if procurement needs an MOU we can circulate, Ben will attach a redlined starter.
3) All: confirm the 10 initial prompts so Monica can prepare the harness.

On attachments: trial-outline-zenova.pdf (attached)

Thanks — I can hop on a quick follow up tomorrow if that helps.

—
Evelyn Hart
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
